figures.shows: The Scene view's row of chips with labels when the view is wide, and the same chips as icons on two rows when it is narrow
figures.caption: A wide Scene view shows every chip with its label in one row. A narrow one draws every chip as an icon and starts a second row when the icons alone do not fit.
figures.alt: Two pictures of the editor's Scene view toolbar. The first shows eleven chips in one row, each with an icon and a label, from Camera to Game camera. The second shows the same chips as icons only, seven on the first row and four on a second.
